submission.justification: Crystal-K2 has the best resolution (2.9% FWHM at 662 keV), but its intrinsic background of 2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day is 4x over the hard budget of 0.5. Most of that background comes from contamination inside the crystal itself, so shielding cannot reduce it. K2 is therefore ruled out. Of the two crystals that pass, K1 (0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day) has much better resolution than K3 (4.5% vs 8.5% FWHM at 5 cm). K1 gives the best resolution available within the constraints. Thickness: 5 cm is the nominal value used in the 2025 simulation. That simulation found resolution depends only weakly on thickness between 3 and 8 cm. No new simulation tool was available in this session, so the thickness was not tuned further. 5 cm is within the 2-10 cm limit and is backed by the existing simulation result.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K1: 4.5% FWHM at 5 cm (2025 sim). This is the best among the crystals that pass the background budget. K2 (2.9%) is excluded by the background limit, and K3 is 8.5%.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
